ideas.title: PBC Schema Validator
ideas.description: Validate incoming W2/HR/Time Tracking data against expected schemas before processing. Flag missing columns, incorrect data types, and formatting issues.
ideas.details: Could use JSON Schema or custom validation rules. Output a report showing which fields passed/failed. Integrate with Alteryx as a pre-processing step.

ideas.title: Smart Field Mapper
ideas.description: AI-assisted tool to suggest field mappings from client column names to standard wireframe fields based on patterns and historical mappings.
ideas.details: Train on historical mappings. Use fuzzy matching and NLP to suggest mappings. Allow user to confirm/adjust. Save new mappings for future reference.

ideas.title: Nuance Database
ideas.description: Searchable log of data nuances encountered and how they were resolved. Build institutional knowledge over time.
ideas.details: Store: client name, data type, issue description, resolution, date. Allow tagging and searching. Export for team training.

ideas.title: Status Email Composer
ideas.description: Generate Thursday status update emails by pulling from activity log. Summarize work done, blockers, and next steps.
ideas.details: Log activities throughout the week. On Thursday, generate draft email with bullet points. Allow editing before sending.

ideas.title: Workflow Recommender
ideas.description: Suggest which workflow approach (WF1-4) to use based on incoming data characteristics and project requirements.
ideas.details: Analyze data columns, row counts, complexity. Recommend WF1 (W2), WF2 (HR), WF3 (Time), or WF4 (Consolidation). Explain reasoning.

ideas.title: Q/NQ Classification Helper
ideas.description: Assist with qualifying percentage decisions by providing guidelines and historical precedents.
ideas.details: Reference IRS guidelines. Show similar past decisions. Flag edge cases for senior review.

ideas.title: Data Quality Dashboard
ideas.description: Visual dashboard showing PBC data quality scores, common issues, and trends across projects.
ideas.details: Score each PBC file on completeness, accuracy, format. Track trends over time. Identify clients with recurring issues.

ideas.title: ET Response Library
ideas.description: Template library for common Engagement Team questions and responses. Reduce time drafting similar emails.
ideas.details: Categorize templates: data requests, clarifications, status updates. Allow customization. Track usage.

ideas.title: Process Timer
ideas.description: Track time spent on each workflow phase. Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.
ideas.details: Start/stop timer for each phase. Generate reports. Compare across projects. Identify slowest steps.

ideas.title: Alteryx Documentation Generator
ideas.description: Auto-generate documentation for Alteryx workflows. Describe inputs, transformations, outputs.
ideas.details: Parse .yxmd files. Extract tool descriptions. Generate markdown or PDF documentation. Include data lineage diagrams.
